0|c8ecfc1c33979054fb631d2066745d03ce322b6f|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"ath10k: fix memory alloc failure in qca99x0 during wmi svc rdy event
Host memory required for firmware is allocated while handling
wmi service ready event. Right now
in tasklet context and it calls dma_alloc_coherent() with atomic
flag (GFP_ATOMIC) to allocate memory in host needed for firmware.
The problem is
the platform (at least in AP platform) where it has less atomic
pool memory (< 2mb). QCA99X0 requires around 2 MB of host memory
for one card
column2: having additional QCA99X0 card in the same platform

column1: will require similarly amount of memory. So
all the platform will have enough atomic memory pool.
Fix this issue
column2: by handling wmi service ready event in workqueue

column1: context and calling dma_alloc_coherent() with GFP_KERNEL. mac80211 work
queue will not be ready at the time of handling wmi service ready.
So
column2: it can't be used to handle wmi service ready. Also

column1: gets scheduled during insmod in existing ath10k_wq and waits for
wmi service ready to completed. Both workqueue can't be used for
this purpose. New auxiliary workqueue is added to handle wmi service
ready.
